featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Dr Soni, for my PCOD & issues around it. The first impression of her was a great fun loving personality until me and my partner started a conversation with her. It was 80 percent one sided.
She did not see my medical PCOS history of 3 years till the very end of the session, this was also because i mentioned it.

Reports were not checked, routine was not heard properly, diet plans were judged & diagnosis given was,  consume this particular tablet and accept that you have gained weight because of PCOD and navigate your way through it, without giving any steps or clarity.
The 20’mins conversation revolved mostly around how she and her two daughters navigate things through hormones without paying any personal attention to my routine.
Any inputs that came from me were negated or unheard.
Any reports later shown were just called numbers.
Agreed, PCOS is a lifestyle disease, but sitting across me was a person who had no interest in listening to my lifestyle and help me with tools. One of the concern was to get my period, she was like its okay even if you dont get it, i stopped listening then & there.
She must be great with her pregnancy experience but not great at humanity experience.
Would not recommend to anyone trying to find their path with PCOD.
